Thanks — quick notes on capacity that we should include in the invite and runbook:

- Baseline recommendation: Hosted trial is fine for functional work and prompt reviews. For the smoke load (200 req/min, peaks to 1,200 tokens) we recommend a short Dedicated slot for the 30–45 minute load window to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Quota bump: request a token budget bump of +500k tokens for the test window (we can scope down if you restrict peaks).
- Rate limits: Increase rate limit to 250 rps for the Dedicated slot, default hosted rate limits will probably throttle at ~60 rps depending on plan.
- Model variant: Use a 7B quantized variant for the load test to get realistic latency; use the full 13B for prompt review if you need quality comparisons.
- Monitoring: We'll attach a lightweight tracing hook and token accounting; Grace will own post-session metrics and next-step recommendations.

I'll add these notes to the runbook and populate capacity-estimates.xlsx. We can support the Apr 6, 15:30–17:30 PST slot — Diego will be on the call.
